benefit: Delhi's face recognition matches 2,930 children without solving a case
for whom: Missing children in care homes in Delhi, under a High Court direction
how the system's work was checked: The High Court recorded that it had not helped solve any missing-child case.
human oversight: The police reported raw match counts to the ministry, and no cited source shows how officers verified a match or contacted a family. In August 2019 the High Court ordered the ministry to chart each identified child and the status of the child's return home.
what must hold for it to happen again: Matches are verified against identity records and followed by reunification, which no cited source shows. The software's match rate is adequate. The police counsel's statement of a two percent match in August 2018 concerned the same software.
what the sources leave unknown: No case of a child reunited with a family through the matches appears in the sources. The Centre for Internet and Society gives 10,617 matches and 3,202 verified identities in a separate report, with no count of reunifications.

The court reports use and training, and a member of the development team reports 80 percent reliability. benefit: Supreme Court of India publishes hearing transcripts from TERES AI
for whom: The Supreme Court of India and readers of its hearing transcripts
how the system's work was checked: The Chief Justice said that lawyers would verify each transcript before publication.
human oversight: The CJI described a procedure in which lawyers would check transcripts before publication and human overseers would resolve overlapping speech. The government confirms in a later account that final validation remained with people.
what must hold for it to happen again: Human vetting capacity, since unpublished transcripts accumulated in March 2023. Handling of overlapping speech in the courtroom.
what the sources leave unknown: Live drafting and publication are distinct outcomes. Nine published transcripts out of 25 early hearings show incomplete delivery. Later reporters use main matters as their denominator, so the counts cannot be combined into a trend. The court and its supplier report no measure of accuracy, gains in accessibility or time saved.

benefit: Chilean prosecutors credit Fiscal Heredia with finding a robbery gang
for whom: Chilean prosecutors, in identifying the members of a gang
how the system's work was checked: not in the sources
human oversight: The model points to probable participants, and prosecutors and police work up those leads. In this case victims later identified the persons of interest that the model raised. The Noveno Juzgado de Garantía accredited the eight robberies. No check of the model's accuracy appears in the sources.
what the sources leave unknown: The prosecutors report detentions. No final conviction or independently measured improvement in identification has been reported. The model’s errors, its contribution beyond the existing arrests and victim identifications, and the court's actual findings would need original records.

for whom: Law students, in legal drafting
how the system's work was checked: Graders scored the work blind.
what must hold for it to happen again: The user must check the model's legal output for errors. The task must be one where the model helps. It helped least on the client memo.

benefit: STF's VitorIA finds at least 247 similar appeals for Tema 1.261
for whom: Brazil's Supreme Court, in screening appeals that raise similar legal questions
how the system's work was checked: not in the sources
human oversight: Court staff reviewed proposed groups, and the justices decided whether a question warranted general-repercussion treatment and how to rule.
what must hold for it to happen again: Appeals filed electronically with machine-readable text. A procedural device (repercussão geral themes) that lets one decision govern many appeals.
what the sources leave unknown: The number of grouped appeals measures what the tool produced. The court has not measured time saved or shown that AI improved the correctness of decisions, access to justice or fairness. Judges made the decision, and the court says that the time gained cannot be calculated.
